categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily manufactures and sells precision micro drills and CNC drilling machines specialized for printed circuit boards (PCBs), along with peripheral PCB processing equipment. It also engages in general import-export trade and agency services. The main products include precision drills and milling cutters of various sizes, with a focus on high-precision tools for IC substrates, HDI, rigid and flexible PCBs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced precision grinding and coating technologies to produce high-quality micro drills and milling cutters. It continuously develops new generation drills for server applications, ABF substrates, automotive electronics, and low-earth orbit satellite applications. The production process emphasizes high yield, stable mass production, and incorporates new coating layers to enhance tool performance and lifespan.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major domestic and international PCB manufacturers serving industries such as computers (desktops, laptops), communications (mobile phones, network products), consumer electronics (tablets, gaming consoles, TVs, wearables), and automotive electronics. The company’s products are critical for PCB drilling and cutting processes, serving high-end markets including AI, 5G, and satellite communications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan and China, with manufacturing facilities including a newly established plant in Thailand to support local supply chains. Sales are distributed across domestic Taiwan, China, and other international markets, with China accounting for the largest revenue share. The company also has subsidiaries and investments in various locations including Shanghai and Thailand.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, specializing in manufacturing precision drilling tools essential for PCB fabrication. It supplies critical components used by PCB manufacturers, who then supply to downstream electronics assembly and device manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening core technology R&D focused on high value-added products, building a technological moat, and promoting smart manufacturing to optimize operational efficiency and cost competitiveness. R&D efforts target micro precision drills, high aspect ratio drills, and coated tools for emerging applications such as AI servers, automotive electronics, and satellite communications. The company also emphasizes sustainability and ESG integration in its operations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of precision drills, milling cutters, CNC drilling machines, and related PCB processing equipment. The company also engages in import-export trade and agency services, but the core revenue driver is the sale of high-precision metal tools for PCB manufacturing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading global supplier of PCB drilling tools with an estimated 10-15% global market share, ranking among the top in the industry. Major competitors include Japanese manufacturers (with one dominant global leader) and domestic Taiwanese firms such as Kaiwei Electronics and Gaoqiao Automation. Chinese competitors focus mainly on lower-end products. The company differentiates itself by focusing on micro-sized (below 0.25mm) and high-performance drills for high-end applications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$3.54 billion, a 29% increase year-over-year, with a net profit of NT$206 million, recovering from a prior loss. The company maintains a healthy financial structure with a debt-to-asset ratio around 29% and continues to invest about 4% of revenue in R&D. It has shown strong growth momentum supported by expanding production capacity and market demand.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes advanced core technologies in precision grinding and coating to deliver high-quality, high-yield micro drills essential for next-generation PCB applications. Its products support high-density, high-frequency, and environmentally friendly PCB materials, meeting stringent customer requirements in AI, 5G, automotive, and satellite markets. The company’s flexible production capacity, cost control, and strong customer relationships provide competitive advantages in a market demanding high precision and reliability.
